notes: NEW UI action cases (5 ops). Push with push_test_cases_to_testrail MCP or local script. Merge-map only — does not update existing TestRail case ids.
preconditions_template:
1. NextGen PP/QA is reachable; log in if not already signed in.
2. Prefer reuse of existing data on the page (no rebuild unless empty).
3. Capture response header correlation-id (not x-correlation-id) from GraphQL.
4. Follow plain-English steps; emit AUDIT_RESULT with real UUID after the mutation.
5. Jira: FDC-14091.

custom_steps_separated.content: Go to Manage → Users and Teams → Servers.
If no server exists, create one; otherwise right-click an existing server → Generate token → accept.
Network filter operationName=RegenerateToken → copy response header correlation-id (NOT x-correlation-id) → emit AUDIT_RESULT.
custom_steps_separated.expected: GraphQL regenerateToken fires; AUDIT_RESULT emitted with real UUID; raw+enrich visible in Generation Status.

custom_steps_separated.content: Create a project if none exists (or open one you can access).
custom_steps_separated.expected: Project is available in left navigation.

custom_steps_separated.content: Right-click the project in the left navigation → Publish project → confirm.
Network filter operationName=PublishProject → copy response header correlation-id → emit AUDIT_RESULT.
custom_steps_separated.expected: GraphQL publishProject fires; AUDIT_RESULT emitted with real UUID.

custom_steps_separated.content: Create a font list if none exists, or open an existing list.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Font list is visible in My Library.

custom_steps_separated.content: Right-click the list → Share list → set Who has access to Only invited → share with any user → confirm.
custom_steps_separated.expected: List sharing updated; updateAssetsSharingInfo mutation captured.

custom_steps_separated.content: Network filter operationName=UpdateAssetsSharingInfo → copy response header correlation-id → emit AUDIT_RESULT.
custom_steps_separated.expected: GraphQL updateAssetsSharingInfo fires; AUDIT_RESULT emitted with real UUID.

custom_steps_separated.content: Click the bell icon → open Notification settings.
Toggle any notification checkbox and click Save changes.
Network filter operationName=BulkUpdatePreferences → copy response header correlation-id → emit AUDIT_RESULT.
custom_steps_separated.expected: GraphQL bulkUpdatePreferences fires; AUDIT_RESULT emitted with real UUID.
